members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The date as YYYY-MM-DD, when the caller controls it. null keeps a controlled field empty. Any other string throws a TypeError.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting date as YYYY-MM-DD, when the field controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new date as YYYY-MM-DD, or with null when the field is cleared.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called with the new open state when the calendar opens or closes, including when choosing a date closes it.

members.name: minValue
members.doc: The earliest date, inclusive. A value before it stays visible and invalid. A minValue later than maxValue throws a TypeError.

members.name: maxValue
members.doc: The latest date, inclusive. A value after it stays visible and invalid.

members.name: unavailableDateMatcher
members.doc: Returns true for a date that is unavailable, given as a YYYY-MM-DD string. An unavailable date cannot be chosen in the calendar.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the calendar is open, when the caller controls it. It is independent of the date: controlling one does not control the other.

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the calendar starts open, when the picker controls itself. Omitted, it starts closed unless a React Aria context supplies defaultOpen.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its date stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string while it is empty.
